faqs: How many guests can you cater for at a wedding?
We cater intimate family weddings as well as large marriage-hall functions. Tell us your expected guest count and we will plan the kitchen, servers and lunch batches to match.
Do you serve on banana leaves or as a buffet?
Both. Many families choose banana-leaf service for the wedding lunch and a buffet for the reception. We can also combine the two.
Can you cater at our marriage hall or at home?
Yes. We cater at marriage halls, temples, community halls and homes across Vellore and nearby towns. Some halls have their own kitchen rules, so share the venue name when you enquire.
When should we book our wedding caterer?
For weddings in the busy muhurtham months such as Thai, Vaikasi, Aavani and Karthigai, book two to three months ahead to be sure of your date.
